# Thinking Orbs (vendored, MIT)

Source: https://github.com/Jakubantalik/thinking-orbs (upstream src/ folder)
Copyright © 2026 Jakub Antalik, MIT (see LICENSE in this folder).

Source files are retained for parity with upstream without requiring npm registry
resolution or lockfile changes in Vercel. Upstream supports prefers-reduced-motion,
dark/light themes, canvas-only rendering and offscreen pause.

Integration points: global PageLoader/PageLoading, chat, dossiês,
WhatsApp conversations, suggested replies, processos.
